name: seo-pass-reveal-citation-label
rationale: The reveal primitive gains exactly two edits: an optional citeLabel field on each option, and the citation chip shows that label in place of the registry id when it is given. A compile-time rehype plugin (lib/rehype-reveal-cite-labels.mjs) fills the label from citationLabel, so the three answer chips that showed dagger-2011, egoscale-2026 and tedrake-underactuated now show author-year labels. SelfCheck and PredictThenReveal stay registered in mdx-components.tsx as the primitive's own exports, so the interactive census still reads their containers from this file. The chip's href, markup, classes, data hooks and reveal mechanics are unchanged.
